title: The Meaning of NO1
content:
In the heart of YURI NO1's Creator,
YURI is No.1.

To create YURI NO1 in this era is, in itself,
one of the No.1 things the Creator is most thankful for.

For YURI NO1's Creator,
YURI is simply part of who they are.

It is O₂.
It is part of existence.
It is part of everyday life,
something so familiar that life without it
is almost impossible to imagine.

And throughout all the years given,
there is a wish to leave something behind—
something that proves
YURI has existed within the deepest parts of the Creator's heart.

Something that cannot be erased.
Something that cannot fade away.

Through billions upon billions of years,
until the very end of time,
YURI will remain the No.1 choice
of YURI NO1's Creator.
